Privacy Policy

How we collect, use and protect your personal information.

props.label: 1Information we collect
props.html:
Last updated: 26 August 2026

ASV Contractors ("we", "us" or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information in an open and transparent way. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and disclose your personal information, and how we comply with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles.

By using our website or providing your information to us, you consent to the collection and use of your information as described in this policy.

1Information we collect

The personal information we collect depends on how you interact with us. It may include:

  • Your name, email address and phone number
  • Your suburb, location or property address
  • The service you are enquiring about and details of your project
  • Any information you include in an enquiry, email or phone call
  • Records of our communications with you

When you visit our website, we may also collect technical information automatically, such as your device type, browser, IP address and how you use the site, through cookies and analytics tools.

2How we collect your information

  • Directly from you, when you complete an enquiry form, call us, email us or speak with our team
  • Automatically, through cookies and website analytics when you browse our website
  • From third parties, such as referral partners or publicly available sources, where relevant to a project

3Why we collect and use your information

We collect and use your personal information to:

  • Respond to your enquiries and provide quotes
  • Deliver and manage our building and construction services
  • Communicate with you about your project, including updates and scheduling
  • Improve our website, services and customer experience
  • Meet our legal, regulatory and insurance obligations

We will only use your information for the purpose it was collected, a related purpose you would reasonably expect, or where you have given consent.

4Disclosure of your information

We may disclose your personal information to:

  • Our staff, contractors and subcontractors involved in delivering your project
  • Consultants, suppliers and delivery partners where needed to complete works
  • Third-party service providers who support our business, such as IT, hosting and administration providers
  • Government or regulatory bodies where required for compliance
  • Any person or body where we are required or authorised to do so by law

We do not sell your personal information to any third party.

5Cookies and website analytics

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to help it function and to understand how visitors use it. Cookies are small files stored on your device. You can disable cookies through your browser settings, although some parts of the website may not work as intended if you do.

6Storage and security of your information

We take reasonable steps to protect your personal information from misuse, loss, unauthorised access, modification or disclosure. Information is stored securely, whether in physical or electronic form, and access is limited to those who need it to carry out their role. Where we use third-party providers to store or process information, we take reasonable steps to ensure they protect it appropriately.

7Overseas disclosure

Some of the service providers we use may store or process information outside Australia. Where this occurs, we take reasonable steps to ensure your information is handled consistently with the Australian Privacy Principles.

8Access and correction

You may request access to the personal information we hold about you, and ask us to correct it if it is inaccurate, out of date or incomplete. To make a request, please contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before providing access.

9Complaints

If you believe we have breached the Australian Privacy Principles or mishandled your personal information, please contact us so we can investigate and respond. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may lodge a complaint with the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) at oaic.gov.au.

10Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The current version will always be available on our website, with the date it was last updated shown at the top of this page.

11Contact us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal information, please contact us:

ASV Contractors
Phone: (02) 8678 6483
Email: asv@asvcontractors.com.au
Seven Hills office: 36/6 Abbott Road, Seven Hills NSW 2147
Beresfield office: 18/13 Balook Drive, Beresfield NSW 2322
